description: This file implements the SystemTime class, which manages system time synchronization, timezone handling, event subscriptions, and time status updates within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes methods for creating system links, subscribing to time-related events, parsing timezone transitions, and maintaining internal state about system time quality and timezone information.

classes.name: SystemTime
classes.description: A class responsible for managing system time synchronization, timezone updates, and event handling within the plugin framework.

methods.name: SystemTime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SystemTime object, starting the event loop thread, and triggering initialization.

methods.name: ~SystemTime
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources, unsubscribes from events, and joins the event thread.

methods.name: IsSystemTimeAvailable
methods.description: Returns whether the system time is currently available and synchronized.

methods.name: GetTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the current timezone offset in seconds and its accuracy.

methods.name: onTimeStatusChanged
methods.description: Event handler for time status change notifications.

methods.name: onTimeZoneDSTChanged
methods.description: Event handler for timezone DST change notifications.

methods.name: CreateSystemLink
methods.description: Establishes a JSONRPC link to the system service, including security token generation.

methods.name: SubscribeForEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to time status and timezone change events via the JSONRPC link.

methods.name: UpdateTimeStatus
methods.description: Queries the current time status and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: UpdateTimeZone
methods.description: Queries and updates the timezone and its accuracy, including transition map population.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses the timezone transition map to determine current timezone offset and accuracy.

methods.name: PopulateTimeZoneTransitionMap
methods.description: Populates the transition map for timezone changes by parsing the output of 'zdump'.

methods.name: EventLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing queued events such as initialization, time status updates, timezone updates, and shutdown.
